items.title: 8.3-8.16 融灾425
items.summary:
兜兜转转还是打了第一个425(我必须考虑这是不是我此生仅有的机会QAQ)
  └ 静寂夏至 (2赞): 大佬.........能帮我打吗🥺
  └ 我真是福哩 (1赞): 个人见解
1—5 血希（应该要三启）和24，直接凹个基伤强效造物进王关，我的练度不够所以只能爽爆死扛（大月卡神力调牌序[傲娇]），如果练度高一点，应该会轻松很多
2—5 1、双鸟，主要应该是看鸟哥和蜘蛛的练度。我是先打两波小怪，再打精英（超级恶心我，爆一次死扛，回复5%已损生命清流血太贱了[酸了]），然后清图进王关。平均每波都要吃3张症状（我说虚弱和扣狂盾不赖[吃瓜]），优先拿生存和回转造物，其次基伤强效
2、防瓜，夏夏老师@静寂夏至 帮我打的[星星眼]，有一定练度（应该至少要三启，没有超限多一管狂气，回转会差点）的地瓜加小玫瑰（一启就可以吧），两队的逻辑应该差不多，也抓生存造物，回转造物就看个人吧
3—5 1、神国，我练度不够（没抽诞墨大人启灵真是抱歉），所以就塞3—5了，刚好又有深海戒指[打call]
2、水船，把自爆用的造物全带上了，再抓了一点能拐能打用不上的角色直接自爆了，原本是想省茉夏的，结果茉夏也没用上[笑哭]
4—5 阿拉克涅，第一队是自己的，在那边蠕动半天，夏夏老师@静寂夏至 看不下去，直接接管（好霸道，好喜欢[喜欢]），直接帮我打两队，也是拿生存，其次回转就行（其他加数值的，除了强效，对阿拉克涅意义不大）
5—5 1、塔潘，不是很会打，一直在蠕动，高练老头凯克斯，羊皮凯肯定更舒服，拿好的力量造物为主吧，可以看看这位老师@断裂免罪符 他有发塔潘视频[呲牙]
2、蚀罗，蚀罗加沙耶道中纯大运（觉醒蚀罗找四费），把省下来的莱克用上了（可怜的塔薇[捂脸]），羊妈其实感觉没那么重要（大概？[热]）

items.title: [负面] Honestly this game's a bit hard to rate for me; I...
items.summary:
Honestly this game's a bit hard to rate for me; I love the gameplay and mechanics, the Gacha aspect is generous [i] (I've managed to get most of the characters I like/need) [/i], and the story is decent. I would talk about all this, but I'd like to harp on my issues.

Character designs are where it falls apart a bit for me; no/few dark-skinned characters. Those who do exist [i] (who I am defining as Wanda, Thais and Goliath) [/i], from what I've seen, are in a little bit of bad taste [i] (at the time of writing I am halfway through chapter 7, where Thais appears) [/i]. Now, is it as bad as Genshin white-washing the cultures entirely? Of course not, but that's an absurdly low bar to clear.

The automatic/AI translation does suck, but the story doesn't suffer too much in my opinion, just the descriptions of some cards/relics that are iffy.

As for the more recent updates that are planned [b] please refer to other recent negative reviews [/b]. I'm not far enough into progression to make any assertions but as it sounds late-game content will be getting worse in the near future and the game will become more pay to win.

Overall it's a fun game suffering from the same issues as 99% of gacha games, just less chronically. I hate that this game has these issues as it has a strong gameplay loop.

[i] P.S. I will return to edit this review if any of these points become void (either via an update or me exploring more of the game) OR these points gets worse, and I want to further detail them. I do apologise if some of them ARE null from later content that I haven't accessed, I just wanted to express my current opinions. And yes, I wouldn't necessarily recommend the game. [/i]

items.title: [DC] psychefu@🔸有問必答┊official-q-a: Issues with the latest announcements:  1)    Having silver in the high score ran
items.summary:
Issues with the latest announcements:

1)    Having silver in the high score range is dumb and very frustrating for a new player. There is no way a new or casual player will ever get those scores in a reasonable amount of time. Especially when upgrading materials are limited as hell and also locked behind difficulty. It's so so so so unfriendly and has way too many barriers.

2) Its true that the silver actually equals very little rolls—but, it’s still a massive fear of missing out aspect that pushing this game into really unfriendly territory. The idea of limiting players by having upgrading materials locked behind extremely difficult content is already dumb and makes it SUPER hard for new players to catch up. Now adding fear of missing out into the mix and at a difficulty less than 10% of the player base is at is just an insult to the majority of the player base.

3) If there are to be rewards in the higher level it should be icons and banners/borders instead. Cosmetic and bragging rights is the way to go.

4) Difficulty should be scaled with the perceptive that Morimens is a game—not for treating Morimens like every player’s job or personal project (i.e., avoid adding tedious stuff within reason. Locking upgrade materials and silver behind millions of HP does not treat Morimens as a game.

5) There was a promise of "you won't need AA for end game content"—where did this perceptive go? Likewise, is Silver not counted as "meaningful rewards"? What the heck does "meaningful rewards" mean then? (see image)
[附件: image.png]
  └ psychefu: Have to send as multiple messages since I don't have discord Nitro... so here is **Part 2**. There will be a **Part 3** later (once the 30 minutes timer has ended and I get back from grocery shopping I guess) as well...

6) Adding Revive does not make increasing HP bloat better. Others have already noted that these DTide changes becomes “more of a chore for casuals when they have to struggle with limited amounts of revives per season with much harder enemies just to get all pulls instead of calling it a day at 325.” I personally agree with this. I wonder how many new players are doing this strategy (I certainly was when I started out about 1 year ago). It’s also worth noting that this style of play pushes the gap between old players and new players wider. Which means BIAV will have even bigger issues going forward as the gap gets bigger and bigger between old and new players. There is a reason other games have a "ceiling" of difficulty. Like Genshin doesn't even have massive power creep and it has been years since its release. Likewise, Arknights is designed at a certain level of difficulty no matter how much power creep is in the new units. That or BIAV really need to add catch up events for new players. Or... have new units be so overpowered that old units become irrelevant (which I don't want to happen and clearly BAIV doesn't too with their character buffs)

items.title: [DC] sunyandmony@🔸有問必答┊official-q-a: I won't be a parrot and repeat everything already said, so I'll do it in my own
items.summary:
I won't be a parrot and repeat everything already said, so I'll do it in my own words + biased opinions

1. The story mode access thing is very nice, but please don't let hp inflation affect the chapters later down the road! Not exactly everyone can predict you'll be greeted with some 20m hp boss at some point while on normal mode at that.. 

2. Rewards being added to make pvp mode/traphase more relevant is a good thing, but it feels a little weird to add them there for some reason.. It would've been better to try and make that mode relevant through other means, like an increase in pulls or silver gains 

3. The Awakener customization frame thingy... I have a very strong opinion on this. I feel like it shouldn't be locked over +15 affinity, nor does it deserve the price it is tagged with. I understand the issues and whatnot with this, but making them different for each Awakener would at least somewhat explain the cost and means, rather than them being similar (example: for Castor and Pollux, they could have matching effects, Arachne could have spider webs, Jenkins little rats, etc etc) and super expensive all at the same time. 

4. As for covenants, I think it's fairly obvious every player here feels at least relatively the same way. So I won't go into it.

5. D-tide, oh man here we go.. While I like a good challenge, I feel like adding so many new things, like a nightmare mode and A6 and A7 will make it a little hard to play, even for people with already invested-in accounts. I do not wish for this game mode to be centered on how much we can spend until the unit is passable enough to clear the content. Additionally, I pray with my heart and soul and everything that I am, to not do hp inflation so early on. Not everyone has cleared the game mode with a full score. If veterans want a challenge, then let them have one. But casual players will definitely feel a lot more pressure on their shoulders as time goes on.

These characters would be completely crippled and useless without these passives intact, especially compared with other future units who will have an arc 3 passive baked into their kits the same way. This also affects arc 1 units who had complete, if outdated, kits who got new life and new use through their soulforge mechanics and became archetype-defining. To scrap Casiah's passive, one of the biggest enablers of Discard teams, would be to hinder the entire team building around them especially when such strong characters like Pontos rely almost entirely on that passive. Other characters received unique synergies like Goliath who despite having no interaction with tentacle damage received a buff that made him work well with the aforementioned iteration of Murphy. Without these passives these fan favorites will fade into obscurity and have no reason to use them going into arc 3. There is the argument that these passives will be part of the new ones to avoid nerfing them post purchase, but that would be lazy design. I have an alternative. 

Instead of replacing passives, make them additive. This keeps characters not only where they are and as strong as they are, but also allows them to become even stronger with new mechanics and new characters. Expand upon Lemurian team building, or develop the poison/counter/bleed/discard archetypes without trying to bulldoze over what was already made. Players shouldn't have to memorize multiple distinct kits for the same character.

items.title: A critically underrated gem.
items.summary:
Morimens is a gem. I’d go as far to say it’s one of the best gacha games out there for gacha gamers who want something more than just run-of-the-mill waifu collectors.

This game is hard as nails. It has countless grotesque, terrifying, Lovecraftian scenes. The number of people who beat the story’s hard mode is in the double digits. It will grind you up to dust and spit you out.

Yet, I keep coming back to it like a drug.

It’s a card battler that plays a lot like Slay the Spire. It has a steampunk aesthetic. So why is it so addictive?

It’s simple- it’s a roguelite that you have endless variety with, with so many bosses and lovely gimmicks. When you have a boss standing over you with over a thousand health and an attack that can one-shot you, you only have one option- see what you can do to get out of this.

If you want a hidden gem that’s so satisfying to play, Morimens won’t disappoint.

The short: Amazing gacha game. The iOS app could use some stability improvements.

The very long:

I wish I could give this 5 stars. It’s a great game with amazing art direction, writing, and isn’t afraid to explore mature themes, given the Lovecraftian nature of the world.

And everything you need to deep dive into the world is in the game itself. A whole library of terms, stories, and radio dramas can be easily viewed within the game.

The gacha itself is pretty generous. To fully unlock a character’s potential might take a lot of duplicate draws but to get the characters themselves, you get plenty of resources to do so.

I only wish the game didn’t crash on iOS like it had a DUI quota. On the plus side, the game is very proactive about saving where you are so a crash loses you no progress. But when I’m going back to the iPhone home screen literally once every chapter or 3 times in a long boss fight, it becomes a very frustrating experience.

Using the fix button on the login screen also did not help the problem. I truly love this game, but I love it a lot more on PC.

items.summary:
吾好梦想封印
期待
炉石国服倒下的那一刻，我没去外服，有两款作为代餐的卡牌游戏映入了我的眼帘，漫威snap和忘却前夜。现在我已经弃坑漫威snap了，一方面太氪了，一方面我觉得确实是忘却前夜更好玩，甚至让我如今国服炉石回归我都想放弃炉石，专精忘却前夜。
作为一个从开服肝到现在的玩家，我觉得这游戏评分不该这么低，至少我在新手时期也就是刚开服的时候深刻体会到校猫（游戏制作人）对玩家和对这款游戏的良苦用心，他是真的愿意让林冲玩家和氪佬都体会到游戏中独有的属于他们的一份乐趣，也愿意在剧情或者角色平衡性这块和玩家一起探讨好坏。基本上每个小版本结束就会发一份问卷，我相信这次活动“花与春天的诗”非常成功离不开每一份问卷的功劳。
至于有些氪金角色强度平衡的麻烦事，官方的补偿说实话很大方，对于我们零氪和微氪玩家来说确实是堪比记忆消除的福利，但对于一些玩家在充值这方面的伤害也确实弥补不回来。希望官方能挺过这几波舆论风波，在以后不会犯下这种失误了。
现在游戏活动模式已经将肝度调整为基本都可接受的程度，活动副本难度面向所有等级的玩家，游戏剧情模式除了后面2章有点难，前面的就算用开局的四小只也能轻松打过，不用担心卡关问题，以前的卡等级在如今也荡然无存（新密契除外）。从开服就算零氪玩到现在也已经能体验99%的游戏内容了，现在入坑就也不知道福利咋样，但多肝肝，等几个月活动就能都复刻一遍。
因为这次活动从游戏性到艺术风格我都很满意，尤其是pv做的相当好。希望忘却前夜能接着保持这份初心，我认为这才是我选择这款游戏的原因。
